email.account_closed_ban.intro: The Budmon administrator closed your account. Your data has been erased.
email.account_closed_ban.subject: Your Budmon account has been closed
email.account_closed_owner.intro: The Budmon administrator closed your account on {now}. Your data will be erased on {date}.
email.account_closed_owner.subject: Your Budmon account has been closed
email.account_deleted.intro: Everything you owned in Budmon has been erased. Copies in backups are gone within 14 days.
email.account_deleted.subject: Your Budmon account has been deleted
email.authenticator_replaced.event: Your two-step verification app was changed
email.authenticator_replaced.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.authenticator_replaced.subject: Your two-step verification app was changed
email.deletion_cancelled.intro: Your account won't be deleted. Reconnect your Gmail and SMS in Sources.
email.deletion_cancelled.subject: Your Budmon account won't be deleted
email.deletion_scheduled.intro: Your account and everything you own in Budmon will be erased on {date}.
email.deletion_scheduled.outro: Sign in before then to keep your account or to download your data.
email.deletion_scheduled.subject: Your Budmon account will be deleted on {date}
email.export_ready.intro: Your export is ready. Download it before {date}.
email.export_ready.subject: Your Budmon export is ready
email.google_linked.event: Google sign-in was connected to your account
email.google_linked.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.google_linked.subject: Google sign-in was connected to your Budmon account
email.google_unlinked.event: Google sign-in was disconnected from your account
email.google_unlinked.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.google_unlinked.subject: Google sign-in was disconnected from your Budmon account
email.invitation.intro: {inviter} invited {email} to Budmon, an app for keeping track of your money.{contextLine}
email.invitation.introNoInviter: You've been invited to Budmon as {email}.
email.invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to Budmon
email.invitation_cap_failed.intro: Budmon has reached its user limit, so {email} couldn't create an account. The administrator has been told.
email.invitation_cap_failed.subject: {email} couldn't join Budmon
email.password_added.event: A password was added to your account
email.password_added.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.password_added.subject: A password was added to your Budmon account
email.password_changed.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.password_changed.subject: Your Budmon password was changed
email.password_reset.intro: Someone asked to reset the password for {email}.
email.password_reset.outro: This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
email.password_reset.subject: Reset your Budmon password
email.password_set.intro: Your account uses Google sign-in. You can also set a password.
email.password_set.outro: This link expires in 30 minutes. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
email.password_set.subject: Set a password for Budmon
email.recovery_code_used.event: A recovery code was used to sign in
email.recovery_code_used.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used to sign in
email.recovery_codes_regenerated.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.recovery_codes_regenerated.subject: New recovery codes were created
email.session_reuse_signed_out.intro: For your security, we signed {device} out on {date}, because its sign-in was used twice.
email.session_reuse_signed_out.outro: If that was you, sign in again on that device.
email.session_reuse_signed_out.subject: We signed you out of Budmon on {device}
email.two_step_disabled.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.two_step_disabled.subject: Two-step verification was turned off
email.two_step_enabled.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.two_step_enabled.subject: Two-step verification was turned on
email.two_step_failed.intro: Someone got past the first sign-in step for your account but not your two-step code, on {date}.
email.two_step_failed.outro: If this wasn't you, change your password and review your security settings.
email.two_step_failed.subject: Someone tried to sign in to Budmon and didn't pass two-step verification
email.two_step_reset_by_owner.intro: The Budmon administrator turned off two-step verification for {email} on {date}.
email.two_step_reset_by_owner.outro: If you didn't ask for this, contact the administrator now.
email.two_step_reset_by_owner.subject: Two-step verification was turned off by the administrator
